request_user:
Fact: eval_results
What to find: Benchmark evaluation results (benchmark, metric, score).
Card sections that often contain it: Evaluation, Benchmarks, Results

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The Evaluation section gives benchmark score tables comparing Falcon-H1R-7B with other models. It covers math, code, general and agentic benchmarks, including AIME24, AIME25, HMMT25, AMO-BENCH, MATH500, LCBv5-v6, SciCode, GPQA-D, MMLU-Pro, HLE, IFBench, τ²-Bench Telecom and Terminal-Bench Hard. For example, Falcon-H1R-7B scores 88.1 on AIME24. A second table reports test-time scaling (TTS) results via DeepConf on AIME24, AIME25, GPQA-D and AMO-Bench*. The card does not name the metric in the tables.
quotes: Falcon-H1R achieves state of art results in reasoning benchmarks.
TTS represents test time scaling results on few of the benchmarks that we evaluated via [DeepConf](https://github.com/facebookresearch/deepconf).
